title: The Meaning of Your Life
author: Arthur C. Brooks
note: The detail that stuck was the monk who spends decades chopping wood and carrying water waiting for enlightenment to change his life, and once he gets it, his teacher just tells him to keep chopping wood and carrying water. I keep waiting for the version of my life where the task list finally looks different.

title: Your Mind, Your Rules
author: Marisa Peer
note: The idea that stuck: your mind can't process a negative — tell it 'don't panic' and it has to picture panic first. Worth remembering next time I'm rehearsing the wrong outcome in my head.

title: Space Between Knowing
author: Subu Sangameswar
note: A reflective exploration of thoughts, uncertainty, and outcomes we don't fully control. It challenges the belief that mindset guarantees results and suggests peace comes from changing our relationship to chance.
